title: Unit Review: Passives and Arguedas
goal: Review the passives with ser, the result with estar and the choice between them in a text about Alcides Arguedas.
grammar: review of the passives and a text about Alcides Arguedas

items: I can read a short text about Alcides Arguedas and his novel Raza de bronce.
I can tell the action (*fue publicada*) from the result (*está ambientada*).
I can choose the right passive to write one sentence about the author and his novel.
